notes: Performance results exclude pilot/general-only batches and the first controls attempt falsely flagged by Host_Error in vr_limits help text.
Full-resolution reference uses the original fragment grid/colour algorithm in the same executable; half resolution is an intentional quality tradeoff, not equivalent output.
CPU frame values include GL/driver waits; do not add CPU/GPU columns or claim CPU simulation speedups.
Screenshot RGB errors include animated screens/lighting and avatar motion; reference-again controls bound background changes but do not prove bit-exact GPU equivalence.

End particle count is a snapshot after measurement; 2048 final batch predated this diagnostic and has no count snapshot. Rolling profiler counts include warm-up and are not identical coverage across variants.
Final rebuild only clarifies menu help/cvar comments; timed binary retained in bench-bin. Fragment, particle-vertex and shared retro GLSL literals are byte-identical in timed and final executables.
